title: Forbidden Files
description: Validates that packs only contain files with allowed extensions and do not include blocked file names or invalid characters. Different pack types (behavior pack, resource pack, world template) have different allowed file type lists.

101.title: File Read Error
101.description: The validator was unable to read the file. This may indicate file corruption or access issues.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the unreadable file

102.title: Invalid Extension
102.description: The file has an extension that is not in the allowed list for this pack type. Remove the file or convert it to an allowed format. Behavior packs, resource packs, and world templates each have specific lists of allowed file extensions.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the file extension that is not allowed

103.title: Blocked Filename
103.description: The file name is on the blocked list and cannot be included in the pack. Certain file names are reserved or prohibited for security or compatibility reasons. Rename or remove the file.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the blocked file name

104.title: Invalid Character
104.description: The file path contains a '$' character which is not allowed in pack file paths. Rename the file or folder to remove the invalid character.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the file path with the invalid character
